sections.h2: West Neck Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 112 residential sales closed in West Neck (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $462,700, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 15 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of West Neck sales closed between $385,158 and $559,250, or about $232 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($497,500, 56 sales) was about 12% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($444,500, 56 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent West Neck sales were in ZIP code 23456.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About West Neck
sections.html: 12% of West Neck sales had four or more bedrooms, against 40% citywide. 28% of West Neck homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so sellers here more often accepted less than the asking price. The median West Neck home is about 1,876 square feet, larger than the 1,706 square foot citywide median.

sections.h2: When West Neck Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in West Neck were busiest in July (20 sales across the two years) and slowest in January (5 sales). Sold prices ran from $300,000 to $695,000, a spread of 2.3x between the lowest and highest sale. 63% of homes closed at or above list price and 4% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in West Neck
sections.html:
54% of the sales were detached homes and 46% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,876 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,712 to 2,400 square feet. 86% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 2002 and 2005, with a median year built of 2003, so this is a mix of homes from the 1990s to the 2010s.
